payload.body_they: People can read a lot into {{Name}} before they know them well. They listen, understand where someone is coming from, and may leave enough space that the other person starts filling in the blanks. {{Name}} can be highly perceptive about tone and atmosphere, but understanding everyone else's perspective can make their own position less obvious. Other people's impressions may contain something true, but {{Name}} still gets to decide which expectations actually belong to them.
